# Lab 4.9: New SQL Features (2026)

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn on reusable column aliases, then try aggregate filtering and multi-level aggregation (both in Preview).

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Turn on reusable column aliases for the project.** Needs a BigQuery admin. Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER PROJECT `YOUR_PROJECT`
SET OPTIONS (`region-us.reusable_column_aliases_mode` = 'on');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It can take a few minutes to apply. To turn it off later, set the value to `'off'`.

2. **[SQL] Reuse an alias in the same SELECT and in WHERE.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  retail_price - cost AS margin,
  margin / retail_price AS margin_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
WHERE margin &gt; 50
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Before the change, `margin` was not visible to `margin_pct` or `WHERE`, and the query failed.

3. **[SQL] Aggregate filtering (Preview).** Count different groups in one pass:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS all_orders,
  COUNT(order_id WHERE status = 'Returned') AS returned,
  COUNT(order_id WHERE status = 'Cancelled') AS cancelled
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The older way is `COUNTIF(status = 'Returned')` or `SUM(IF(...))`.

4. **[SQL] Multi-level aggregation (Preview).** Average of the daily totals in one query, without a subquery:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE(created_at)) AS month,
  AVG(COUNT(*) GROUP BY DATE(created_at)) AS avg_orders_per_day
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Preview syntax can change. If the query fails, check the current **Aggregate functions** page in the GoogleSQL docs.

5. **[CLI] Check the project setting.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT option_name, option_value FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PROJECT_OPTIONS WHERE option_name LIKE "%alias%"'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Reusable aliases | Work in SELECT and WHERE after opt-in |
| Aggregate filter | `COUNT(order_id WHERE …)` per group |
| Multi-level aggregation | Aggregate of an aggregate in one query |
| Status | Aliases GA (opt-in); the other two in Preview |
